question: How long does the complete synthetic hero workflow take in one source-only GitHub Actions environment, from creating an owned shoot day to verified handoff downloads?

source_baseline.identity_rule: Bind protocol commit/hash, instrument HEAD, independent frontend/backend source trees, served frontend asset hashes and observed backend health revision before and after. Refuse mismatches. These are local source identities, not AWS releases.

sampling.browser: Chromium desktop from the existing locked Playwright dependency
sampling.order: Sequential sample indices 1 through 10; fresh browser context and owned synthetic session per sample; same local server processes throughout.
sampling.warmup: None. Preserve first-sample cache/start effects that fall inside the timing boundary.
sampling.failure_rule: Continue remaining scheduled samples after a failure. Never retry, replace, discard or add samples. Preserve scheduled, started, stage and final records; unstarted or interrupted samples stay NOT_RUN or INCOMPLETE, never zero-duration successes.
sampling.execution_budget: One manual source benchmark dispatch after instrument tests pass. Instrument failure must be reported; another measured cohort needs a separately recorded decision, never silent rerun.

timing.clock: Monotonic performance.now in the browser driver process; milliseconds as unrounded raw numbers.
timing.start: Immediately before clicking Start this fictional shoot day, after initial page navigation and readiness of that control.
timing.end: Immediately after the unchanged shared close stage returns, having verified downloaded turnover JSON, downloaded handoff recommendations against the saved manifest, downloaded wrap receipt and visible handoff take identity.
timing.included: Browser controls, API work, reloads, polling/assertions, downloads, scripted human-role actions and measurement instrumentation within the boundary. This is automation completion time, not human-active time or model inference latency.
timing.excluded: Dependency install, build, server startup, initial navigation, pre/postflight provenance checks, post-workflow clipboard exercises, artifact upload and summary rendering. No narration holds, screenshots, traces or video recording are enabled.
timing.failed_elapsed: Retain elapsed time and completed/failed stages separately. A timed-out or partial sample is not a completed-workflow latency.

network_and_cost.network_policy: During the measured workflow, browser requests are same-origin only; backend provider client construction and outbound network are refused and counted. Package installation by GitHub Actions is outside the boundary.
network_and_cost.runtime: Real Strands sessions with local durable adapters, offline-scripted/1.0.0 planning and offline-lexical/1.0.0 interpretation. Not semantic-AI or creative/legal clearance.
network_and_cost.model_calls: Paid/external model invocations must be observed as 0 with installed fail-closed guards and per-sample counters. Scripted planner calls are separately counted and must not be described as 0 model activity.
network_and_cost.model_cost_usd: 0 only for the guarded source-only paid-model path; unknown if guard evidence is absent or incomplete.
network_and_cost.other_costs: No claim of zero total cost: GitHub Actions, compute, storage and human cost are not metered. No AWS benchmark, paid model, mail or recording is authorized.

reporting.raw: Preserve every sample index, outcome, stage start/end/elapsed milliseconds, total elapsed, API request counts and body byte counts, guard/planner counters, provenance and sanitized failure class/stage. Missing byte observations remain unknown, not 0. Do not retain session handles, request/response bodies, headers or arbitrary error text.
reporting.statistics: Report success/failure/incomplete/not-run counts over 10. Median is the middle success value or mean of the two middle success values; p95 uses nearest-rank ceil(0.95 * successful_n); max uses successful samples only. Print successful_n beside all successful-duration statistics and each stage. For 10 successes nearest-rank p95 equals max. Empty aggregates are null. Report failed elapsed separately.
reporting.retention: Always upload raw records and human-readable HTML summary with SHA256 artifact manifest for 90 days, even after failure. Do not overwrite historical docs/measurement.json or earlier evidence.
reporting.claims: A bounded descriptive source-CI observation on one synthetic workflow and environment. No statistical advantage, baseline speedup, population inference, real-user benefit, production latency or AWS monetary estimate. Human UAT remains NOT_RUN and production video remains NOT_CONFIGURED.
